name: Apothecary Renferrel
summary: Apothecary Renferrel is a prominent member of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Tasked with advancing the Forsaken's alchemical endeavors, he coordinates extensive field research into the region's corrupted wildlife and undead threats. Travelers through Silverpine frequently assist him with gathering volatile reagents and investigating dangerous Scourge remnants.

sections.title: The Sepulcher's Alchemist
sections.body: Operating out of the Sepulcher, Renferrel serves as one of the Royal Apothecary Society's chief field researchers in Silverpine Forest. While Undercity houses the grand laboratories and high leadership of the society, Renferrel handles the practical, muddy work of securing native biological specimens, refining potent concoctions, and analyzing the grim ecology of Lordaeron's western border.

sections.title: Investigating Rot Hide and Scourge
sections.body: Renferrel directs much of his energy toward the Rot Hide gnolls and rogue undead infesting the region. Through blood and tissue samples, he seeks to understand the lingering touch of the plague and the necromantic forces binding local monsters. His investigations lead him into direct opposition with Thule Ravenclaw, a powerful Scourge necromancer operating near the ruins of Fenris Isle.

faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel is an alchemist of the Royal Apothecary Society based in the Sepulcher, the main Forsaken outpost in Silverpine Forest. He studies local beasts, plague variations, and enemy forces to brew concoctions and secure the region for Queen Sylvanas.

faq.q: What does Renferrel research in Silverpine?
faq.answer: He focuses on developing new plagues and venomous mixtures, known broadly as a 'Recipe for Death'. He tasks adventurers with collecting grizzly bear hearts, Rot Hide gnoll ichor, and other biological components to test and refine lethal concoctions.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Rot Hide gnolls?
faq.answer: Renferrel studies the Rot Hide gnolls' corrupted ichor. His initial tests detect warlock and necromantic magic, so he sends a sample to Bethor Iceshard in Undercity for further study.

faq.q: Why does Renferrel target Thule Ravenclaw?
faq.answer: Renferrel investigates the magic behind the Rot Hide gnolls and seeks Bethor Iceshard's help in identifying its source. The investigation leads toward the threats on Fenris Isle.

faq.q: Where does Renferrel send adventurers after Silverpine?
faq.answer: Once his initial research and the local threats are addressed, Renferrel directs seasoned travelers southeast to Hillsbrad Foothills, connecting the Sepulcher's frontier efforts with broader Forsaken operations in Lordaeron.

faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society is the scientific and alchemical branch of the Forsaken, founded under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. Headquartered in Undercity, its researchers work tirelessly to develop new poisons, resist natural decay, and craft a plague capable of eradicating the Scourge.

angles.text: Renferrel represents the pragmatic, ruthless survival mindset of the Forsaken, weaponizing Lordaeron's native flora and fauna to build a secure future for the freed undead.
While orcs and tauren may balk at the gruesome nature of his biological experiments, Renferrel's intelligence gathering against the Scourge helps keep Horde territories safe from northern incursions.
